project.name: Contract fixture
project.notes: A synthetic, redistributable project exercising every version-1 concept: three disks and a support directory in one source set, two HUNK modules with overlapping numeric addresses, a derived image, a palette, raw audio, a table, symbols, a function with a register local, comments, a deliberately stale annotation, and a PNG artifact with provenance. No original media: every byte here is generated by the fixture builder.
